text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Is that... a picture book reading? Hehe, 
looks fun.

text_block_list.name: Kindergarten Girl
text_block_list.text:
Are you curious, big sis? Then let's 
listen together!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah, are you sure? Well then... maybe I'll 
listen in for just a bit.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Princess, I'm so, so happy for you...! 
You finally found your precious ring..."

text_block_list.name: Kindergarten Girl
text_block_list.text:
Big sis...? Are you okay? I've got a 
handkerchief.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah... hehe, I'm okay. Thank you. The 
teacher was just so good at telling 
stories...

text_block_list.name: Kindergarten Teacher
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...! Thank you so much! Um, if 
you'd like, would you care to join us for 
the rest? The children seem to have taken 
a liking to you as well...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Is that really okay? Thank you so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Kindergarten Girl
text_block_list.text:
We're in this together, big sis! Even if 
you cry, I'll be right here with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista gets so absorbed in picture 
books with the kids that she ends up 
skipping her training...
